topics.name: Google I/O & Agentic AI
topics.summary: Google's I/O event was dominated by AI, showcasing new Gemini models (3.5 Flash, Omni), agentic AI capabilities, deep integration into Workspace (Gmail, Docs, Keep), AI-powered search, smart glasses, and tools for AI app development, signaling a future where AI performs tasks proactively.

topics.name: AI Development & Trust
topics.summary: The AI landscape is grappling with content provenance, as OpenAI adopts Google's SynthID watermarking, while a legal battle between Elon Musk and Sam Altman over OpenAI's origins concluded. Other developments include new defenses against AI phishing and an acquisition by Mistral AI.

topics.name: Space Exploration & Science
topics.summary: NASA's Psyche mission successfully performed a gravity-assist Mars flyby, capturing detailed images of the Martian surface, and is now en route to its metal-rich asteroid target. Separately, NASA's science chief emphasized the need for mass-produced satellites, and a new citizen science project 'Shock Detectives' was launched.

topics.name: Consumer Tech & Services
topics.summary: Plex announced a significant price hike for its lifetime pass. Google's Wear OS 7 will introduce Live Updates. Nintendo released a Switch 2 bundle, Discord enabled end-to-end encryption for voice/video, and new trackers and high refresh rate monitors were also released.

topics.name: Cybersecurity & Surveillance
topics.summary: The FBI is seeking broad access to nationwide license plate camera data, raising privacy concerns. Separately, CISA suffered a major security lapse with credentials found publicly on GitHub, and a report highlighted the industrialization of cybercrime.

topics.name: Tech Policy & Regulation
topics.summary: Minnesota became the first state to ban prediction markets. Democrats previewed potential action against the Ticketmaster settlement, and Congress's transportation bill includes an annual EV registration fee.

topics.name: Software Development
topics.summary: New observability platform Superlog aims to automate logging and bug fixing, while discussions explored common pitfalls for open-source projects and fundamental concepts like TTYs.

topics.name: Industry & Environment
topics.summary: A major electrical utility merger driven by data center needs could lead to higher consumer bills. Other industry news includes an acquisition in defense tech, a Tesla lithium refinery's wastewater discharge, and Cloudflare's integration with Anthropic's AI agents.
